  • 方法详细资料

    • getVariant

      Horse.Variant getVariant()
      Gets the horse's variant. 获取该马的品种。

      A horse's variant defines its physical appearance and capabilities. Whether a horse is a regular horse, donkey, mule, or other kind of horse is determined using the variant. 马的品种决定其外观与能力。马是普通马、驴、骡子还是其他种类，由品种决定。

      返回:
      a Horse.Variant representing the horse's variant 表示该马品种的 Horse.Variant

    • setVariant

      void setVariant(Horse.Variant variant)
      Sets the horse's variant. 设置该马的品种。

      A horse's variant defines its physical appearance and capabilities. Whether a horse is a regular horse, donkey, mule, or other kind of horse can be set using the variant. 马的品种决定其外观与能力。马是普通马、驴、骡子还是其他种类，可通过品种来设置。

      Setting a horse's variant does not change its attributes such as its owner and its tamed status, but changing a mule or donkey with a chest to another variant which does not support a chest will remove the chest and its contents. 设置马的品种不会改变其属性（如主人与驯服状态），但将携带箱子的骡子或驴改为不支持箱子的其他品种时，箱子及其内容将被移除。

      参数:
      variant - a Horse.Variant for this horse 该马的 Horse.Variant

    • getColor

      Horse.Color getColor()
      Gets the horse's color. 获取该马的颜色。

      Colors only apply to horses, not to donkeys, mules, skeleton horses or undead horses. 颜色只适用于普通马，不适用于驴、骡子、骷髅马或亡灵马。

      返回:
      a Horse.Color representing the horse's group 表示该马分组的 Horse.Color

    • setColor

      void setColor(Horse.Color color)
      Sets the horse's color. 设置该马的颜色。

      Attempting to set a color for any donkey, mule, skeleton horse or undead horse will not result in a change. 尝试为驴、骡子、骷髅马或亡灵马设置颜色不会产生任何变化。

      参数:
      color - a Horse.Color for this horse 该马的 Horse.Color

    • getStyle

      Horse.Style getStyle()
      Gets the horse's style. 获取该马的样式。 Styles determine what kind of markings or patterns a horse has. 样式决定马拥有何种斑纹或花纹。

      Styles only apply to horses, not to donkeys, mules, skeleton horses or undead horses. 样式只适用于普通马，不适用于驴、骡子、骷髅马或亡灵马。

      返回:
      a Horse.Style representing the horse's style 表示该马样式的 Horse.Style

    • setStyle

      void setStyle(Horse.Style style)
      Sets the style of this horse. 设置该马的样式。 Styles determine what kind of markings or patterns a horse has. 样式决定马拥有何种斑纹或花纹。

      Attempting to set a style for any donkey, mule, skeleton horse or undead horse will not result in a change. 尝试为驴、骡子、骷髅马或亡灵马设置样式不会产生任何变化。

      参数:
      style - a Horse.Style for this horse 该马的 Horse.Style

    • isCarryingChest

      boolean isCarryingChest()
      Gets whether the horse has a chest equipped. 获取该马是否装备有箱子。
      返回:
      true if the horse has chest storage 若该马拥有箱子存储则为 true

    • setCarryingChest

      void setCarryingChest(boolean chest)
      Sets whether the horse has a chest equipped. Removing a chest will also clear the chest's inventory. 设置该马是否装备箱子。移除箱子也将清空箱子的物品栏。
      参数:
      chest - true if the horse should have a chest 若该马应拥有箱子则为 true

    • getDomestication

      int getDomestication()
      Gets the domestication level of this horse. 获取该马的驯化度。

      A higher domestication level indicates that the horse is closer to becoming tame. As the domestication level gets closer to the max domestication level, the chance of the horse becoming tame increases. 驯化度越高表示该马越接近被驯服。驯化度越接近最大驯化度，马被驯服的几率就越大。

      返回:
      domestication level 驯化度

    • setDomestication

      void setDomestication(int level)
      Sets the domestication level of this horse. 设置该马的驯化度。

      Setting the domestication level to a high value will increase the horse's chances of becoming tame. 将驯化度设为较高的值将提高该马被驯服的几率。

      Domestication level must be greater than zero and no greater than the max domestication level of the horse, determined with getMaxDomestication() 驯化度必须大于零且不超过该马的最大驯化度（由 getMaxDomestication() 确定）

      参数:
      level - domestication level 驯化度

    • getMaxDomestication

      int getMaxDomestication()
      Gets the maximum domestication level of this horse. 获取该马的最大驯化度。

      The higher this level is, the longer it will likely take for the horse to be tamed. 该值越高，驯服该马所需的时间可能就越长。

      返回:
      the max domestication level 最大驯化度

    • setMaxDomestication

      void setMaxDomestication(int level)
      Sets the maximum domestication level of this horse. 设置该马的最大驯化度。

      Setting a higher max domestication will increase the amount of domesticating (feeding, riding, etc.) necessary in order to tame it, while setting a lower max value will have the opposite effect. 设置更高的最大驯化度将增加驯服所需的驯化量（喂食、骑乘等），而设置更低的值则效果相反。

      Maximum domestication must be greater than zero. 最大驯化度必须大于零。

      参数:
      level - the max domestication level 最大驯化度

    • getJumpStrength

      double getJumpStrength()
      Gets the jump strength of this horse. 获取该马的跳跃力量。

      Jump strength defines how high the horse can jump. A higher jump strength increases how high a jump will go. 跳跃力量决定该马能跳多高。跳跃力量越高，跳得越高。

      返回:
      the horse's jump strength 该马的跳跃力量

    • setJumpStrength

      void setJumpStrength(double strength)
      Sets the jump strength of this horse. 设置该马的跳跃力量。

      A higher jump strength increases how high a jump will go. Setting a jump strength to 0 will result in no jump. You cannot set a jump strength to a value below 0 or above 2. 跳跃力量越高，跳得越高。将跳跃力量设为 0 将导致无法跳跃。不能将跳跃力量设为低于 0 或高于 2 的值。

      参数:
      strength - jump strength for this horse 该马的跳跃力量
